overview_description.description:
Banuba is an augmented reality company with over 7 years on the market, pioneering face tracking and virtual background technologies. 

Our expertise helps clients harness the power of AR to foster business growth:

1. Face AR SDK can remove backgrounds, add AR masks, place virtual makeup, create touchless interfaces and more.

2. TINT — Realistic virtual makeup try-on with auto seasonal color analysis, a unique solution in digital makeup.

3. Video Editor SDK/API. A full-fledged mobile video editor with AR features included. Reduces app time-to-market by up to 50%.

Banuba has also made notable gains in hand tracking. This technology allows controlling electronic devices with gestures, as well as accurately trying on hand jewelry.

Business evaluation of the company reached $30 million after the first round of funding and $100 million after the second.

about_short_description.short_description: Banuba is an augmented reality company, pioneering face tracking and virtual background technologies.

product.name: Face AR SDK
product.description: A cross-platform augmented reality development kit for face detection, tracking, hand gestures, virtual backgrounds, beauty effects, color filters, and interactive face augmentations.

product.name: Video Editor SDK | API
product.description: A software development kit and API for adding video creation and editing capabilities, including trimming, merging, drafts, captions, picture-in-picture, augmented reality effects, and other media tools.

product.name: TINT Virtual Try-On
product.description: An augmented reality commerce platform that lets shoppers virtually try makeup, eyewear, jewelry, hair products, headwear, and other items using camera-based visualization and product recommendations.

product.name: Banuba Virtual Try-On Plugin
product.description: An e-commerce plugin that adds browser-based augmented reality try-on for makeup, eyewear, jewelry, headwear, hair color, and related products to supported commerce platforms.

product.name: Background Changer API
product.description: An API and SDK for removing people or objects from image and video backgrounds and replacing them with images, videos, GIFs, blurred scenes, or 3D environments.

product.name: Avatar SDK
product.description: A cross-platform SDK for creating animated 3D or photorealistic avatars that reproduce a user’s facial movements and expressions in real time.
